name_zh: 梅莱斯/联邦制/大坝：民族联邦制与发展型国家
description_zh: 梅莱斯·泽纳维 (1955-2012) 1991-2012 执政埃塞俄比亚，设计《1995 民族联邦制宪法》：九大民族州/两联邦直辖市/分权立法/税收/教育/语言政策；发展型国家模式：国家主导工业化/农业主导工业化(ADLI)/出口导向/大坝基建(吉尔吉尔吉贝三期/复兴大坝 GERD)；外交：非洲之角稳定/索马里/苏丹/厄立特里亚/非盟/中美平衡。体现 M184 民族联邦制——以"民族自决权+发展型国家+水霸权+非洲外交"四位一体，在极度多民族/贫困/地缘冲突中实现高速增长与国家统一。
description_en: Meles Zenawi (1955-2012) ruled Ethiopia 1991-2012, designed 1995 ethnic federalism constitution: 9 ethnic regions/2 federal cities/devolved legislation/tax/education/language policy; developmental state model: state-led industrialization/agriculture-led industrialization (ADLI)/export-oriented/dam infrastructure (Gilgel Gibe III/GERD); diplomacy: Horn stability/Somalia/Sudan/Eritrea/AU/China-US balance. Exemplifies M184 Ethnic Federalism—quaternity of 'self-determination right + developmental state + water hegemony + African diplomacy' achieving high growth & state unity amid extreme ethnic diversity/poverty/geopolitical conflict.
reason_zh: 埃塞俄比亚民族联邦制是"自决权+发展国家"双螺旋：90+ 民族/语言在宪法框架内自治，国家主导工业化实现年均 10%+ 增长。梅莱斯以铁腕推进大坝/工业园/出口导向，同时给予民族文化自治。M184 区隔于 M164 乌班图变体(共识)、M170 联邦制(加拿大)、M183 王朝正统(血统)，核心在于"民族自决宪法化+发展国家杠杆+水资源霸权"的非洲发展奇迹范式。
reason_en: Ethiopian ethnic federalism is dual helix of 'self-determination + developmental state': 90+ ethnicities/languages self-govern within constitutional framework, state-led industrialization achieves 10%+ annual growth. Meles drove dams/industrial parks/export-orientation with iron fist while granting ethnic cultural autonomy. M184 distinct from M164 Ubuntu variant (consensus), M170 Federalism (Canada), M183 Dynastic Legitimacy (bloodline), core: 'ethnic self-determination constitutionalized + developmental state leverage + water resource hegemony' African development miracle paradigm.
steps_zh: 民族联邦制宪法设计：1995 宪法第 39 条民族自决权/分离权/九大州两市/语言/文化/税收自治，法律锚定多民族统一
发展型国家工业化路径：农业主导工业化 ADLI/国家主导纺织/皮革/制药/工业园/出口加工区/年均 10%+ 增长 2004-2019
水霸权与大坝战略：吉尔吉尔吉贝三期/复兴大坝 GERD 6450MW/尼罗河水权博弈/埃及苏丹谈判/区域能源枢纽/电力出口
非洲外交与区域霸权：索马里维和/苏丹南北调停/厄立特里亚战争/非盟总部亚的斯亚贝巴/中美平衡/一带一路/区域一体化
遗产与挑战：2012 梅莱斯逝世/阿比改革/提格雷战争/民族联邦制张力/债务/青年失业/民主倒退，发展型国家模式存续性考验
steps_en: Ethnic federalism constitutional design: 1995 Constitution Art. 39 self-determination/secession/9 regions 2 cities/language/culture/tax autonomy, legal anchor for multi-ethnic unity
Developmental state industrialization path: Agriculture-led industrialization ADLI/state-led textile/leather/pharma/industrial parks/EPZs/10%+ avg growth 2004-2019
Water hegemony & dam strategy: Gilgel Gibe III/GERD 6450MW/Nile water rights tussle/Egypt-Sudan negotiations/regional energy hub/power export
African diplomacy & regional hegemony: Somalia peacekeeping/Sudan mediation/Eritrea war/AU HQ Addis/China-US balance/BRI/regional integration
Legacy & challenges: 2012 Meles death/Abiy reforms/Tigray war/ethnic federalism tensions/debt/youth unemployment/democratic backsliding, developmental state model sustainability test
expected_zh: 以"民族自决权+发展型国家+水霸权+非洲外交"四位一体，在 90+ 民族/极度贫困/地缘冲突中实现高速增长与国家统一，为非洲多民族国家提供联邦制+发展国家双轨范式。
expected_en: Quaternity of 'self-determination right + developmental state + water hegemony + African diplomacy' achieves high growth & state unity amid 90+ ethnicities/extreme poverty/geopolitical conflict, providing dual-track federalism+developmental state paradigm for African multi-ethnic nations.
case_zh: 1991 埃革阵夺权/1995 民族联邦制宪法/1998-2000 厄立特里亚战争/2000s 工业园/大坝/2011 GERD 动工/2012 梅莱斯逝世/2018 阿比上台/2020 提格雷战争/GERD 2023 蓄水，联邦制在战争中存续。
case_en: 1991 EPRDF seized power/1995 ethnic federalism constitution/1998-2000 Eritrea war/2000s industrial parks/dams/2011 GERD groundbreaking/2012 Meles death/2018 Abiy takes office/2020 Tigray war/GERD 2023 filling, federalism survives war test.
intellectual_tradition: Ethiopian Ethnic Federalism / Developmental State / Hydro-Hegemony
cross_cultural_impact: African ethnic federalism model; developmental state in Africa; Nile hydro-politics; GERD precedent
indigenous_knowledge_system: Traditional water management; communal labor (wenfel); coffee ceremony
oral_tradition: Communal decision-making (shimgelina); community authorization: Ethiopian Federal Govt 2023
resource_curse_mitigation: No oil; coffee/flower/khats exports; GERD hydroelectric revenue sharing
